description: Nouvelle-Aquitaine : Trafic routier 2011-2015 des réseaux autoroutiers non concédé, national et départemental - Localisation (ponctuel) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by datacarto.sigena.fr. This dataset contains the location of counting points describing the traffic of the unlicensed motorway network, national and departmental networks in the New Aquitaine region for the years 2011 to 2015, year N being 2015. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "New-Aquitaine: Road traffic 2011-2015 of unlicensed, national and departmental motorway networks — Location (on-call)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include données ouvertes, non concédé, trafic, routiers, tmja, tmjm. The listing shows 2017-09-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
